summary: Today (Tue) is the peak — Ditch and Matunuck both offer clean chest-high morning waves with offshore dawn winds, the only real size of the week. Rockaway and Lido are fine for a glassy dawn log but not worth a drive, and if you're chasing today, Ditch is the smarter call. The rest of the week fades to knee-and-waist windswell; the weekend brings longer-period lines but too little size to matter, and Monday's return of swell is short-period and windy across the board.
